description: The pie chart visually represents the distribution of attribution evaluation across various domains as analyzed in the paper “Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models.” It is divided into ten distinct segments, each labeled with a domain category and its corresponding percentage. The largest segment, colored blue, represents “AI/NLP Research” at 24.3%, dominating the chart. The second largest, in teal, is “Finance” at 8.2%, followed by “History” and “Game & Anime,” both also at 8.2%, shown in pink and orange respectively. Other segments include “Med & Health” (6.7%, yellow), “Science” (6.7%, light blue), “Daily Life” (7.1%, light green), “Pet & Animal” (5.5%, green), “Law” (5.1%, red), “Business” (5.9%, dark red), “Geography” (2.7%, olive green), and “Math” (1.2%, dark green). Each slice is clearly labeled with a leader line pointing to its percentage, and the segments are arranged in a roughly descending order clockwise from the top. The chart uses a vibrant, multi-color palette to distinguish categories, with no exploded slices or 3D effects, maintaining a clean and informative presentation.
